name: htmlhub
description: HTML Static Page Management & Display Platform

scripts.dev: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/parallel.ts "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.start: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/parallel.ts "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
